def transform(g):
    n=len(g)
    cw=[ [g[n-1-r][c] for r in range(n)] for c in range(n)]
    ccw=[ [g[r][n-1-c] for r in range(n)] for c in range(n)]
    rot180=[ [g[n-1-r][n-1-c] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    return [g[r]+cw[r] for r in range(n)] + [ccw[r]+rot180[r] for r in range(n)]
